items.author: Omari Sankofa II
items.body_excerpt:
FINAL: Pistons 109, Suns 107. Okorie hit the game-winning layup with 5.8 seconds left, then defended Bouyea during the potential game-winning 3 attempt. Awesome moment for the rookie. 

Pistons rallied from a 19-point deficit to win this one. Lots of good stuff in the second half
